answer: An optical challenge protocol counters Sybil attacks by binding each agent to the scattering pattern of a physical pigment token. Probing sensors illuminate the substrate beside a ceramic ember that provides an infrared baseline, measuring angle-resolved photon dispersion. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of synthesizing distinct micro-structured tokens per identity. However, atmospheric beam wander can misalign sensor apertures, spuriously rejecting legitimate agents.
